name: HighTone Seaview Villas & Garden
developer: Phuket9 Real Estate Development Co., Ltd.
shortDescription: Eleven three-storey 4- and 5-bedroom sea-view pool villas of 530 to 590 sqm on the hillside about 1 km from Karon Beach.
description:
HighTone Seaview Villas & Garden is a gated estate of 11 pool villas by the Rawai-based developer Phuket9, on the hillside above Karon about 1 km from Karon Beach. The villas are three storeys high and face west over the Andaman Sea, with four or five bedrooms, built-up areas of about 530 to 590 sqm and plots of about 446 to 570 sqm.
Each villa has its own pool and a roof terrace, and the estate has shared landscaped gardens, a gym, covered parking and round-the-clock security. Owners can place their villa in a hotel-managed rental programme. Patong and the Jungceylon mall are about 10 minutes away by car; Patong Hospital is about 5 km away.
Foreign buyers take the land on a 30-year lease renewable twice. The developer lists the project as under construction; the completion date published by agents (Q1 2026) has passed, so check the build stage with us before booking.
